name: metrics-benchmark-dolly-dataset
description: A dataset collected to evaluate automatic evaluation metrics by comparing model outputs (often instruction-following responses) against human judgments. It provides reference model outputs and human quality ratings to benchmark how well automatic metrics correlate with human preference and to assess metric robustness across response types. It is intended for research on evaluation metrics rather than for training generation models.
evaluation_method: human_eval (used to compute correlation between automatic metrics and human judgments)
reputation: A niche dataset used primarily for metric-evaluation research with modest community visibility via Hugging Face.
